design: AMR A6-D2 CNC grid deck with PLA accessory fixtures

geometry.battery_service: Remove cargo/straps, unplug deck accessory harness, undo six M6 bolts, lift deck/fixtures and remove six loose blocks; battery then exits upward. Power isolated first.
geometry.support_change_reason: Six20x15x15 compression blocks at x=-105,0,105 and y=+-135 free the36 grid nut/tool positions; continuous supported-strip model is no longer the acceptance model.

hardware.frame_bolt: M6x30 socket screw plus two JIS B1256 grade A M6 washers per bolt
hardware.slot_nut_geometry_status: Provided by assembly slotnut_factory(x,y,99,(0,0,-1)); absent callback omits six nuts from CAD and carries8g/each mass allowance; no old geometry reused.
hardware.frame_washer: M6 JIS B1256 grade A / ISO7089 nominal12x6.4x1.6
hardware.tolerance_note: 0.23mm is a partial stack calculation only (plate3.85..4.15, bar15 nominal, two washers2.8..3.6, bolt29.58..30.42); bar/slot/nut tolerances excluded. Measure all six stacks, select washer pairs/bolt lengths so nominal penetration7.5..8.0 and confirm actual floor clearance>=1mm. Complete thread engagement/preload remain separate checks.

cargo_conditions.pressure_distribution_for_plate_SF2_scre: Approximately uniform over central continuous200x200. CG envelope for vehicle reactions is not proof of this pressure distribution.
cargo_conditions.point_feet_or_hard_point_load: Not approved; add a separately checked load-spreader or re-evaluate actual contacts.
cargo_conditions.restraint: Four metal stops and two perpendicular25mm cam-buckle straps. Container sides must bear on stops; protect strap edges, retain slack, hand tension only. No lifting.
cargo_conditions.strap_pretension_limit_status: Target20N/strap. Use a force gauge or spring balance to limit tail pull and verify retained tension on actual restraint fixture; no unchecked hand-tight/rachet operation. Measuring equipment unselected and excluded from materials budget.50N sensitivity is not permission.
cargo_conditions.operation_scope: Level smooth indoor floors only; former 8 kg / 5 degree case is reference only in requirements.json.

structural_screening.proof_stress_status: Procurement acceptance target for6061-T6; require lot properties. Solver comparison does not certify full AMR.
excluded: Actual nonuniform cargo/contact and point feet
Local bolt preload, frame slot/nut engagement and support contact
Upward strap-anchor reactions: separate local analytical check only
structural_screening.pretension_basis: Four vertical legs each20N add80N to payload+1.6kg dead allowance. Treated as uniform200x200 equivalent load; actual rigid bottom spread/contact must be verified. Gauge-limited tail pull and actual tension check are prerequisites, not just a hand-tight warning.
structural_screening.model_status: Old continuous strip retained only as sanity comparison. Six-support perforated-shell FEA is required.

plate.basis: D2 STEP/PDF uploaded toJLCCNC; qty1 economic10days,6061-T6 requested,as-machined,UPS Japan. Automatic estimate; manual review pending.

square_bar.basis: Same purchased995mm stock; cut six20mm supports plus four50mm stops,320mm finished+30mm kerf allowance. Alloy/temper unconfirmed; compression comparison below.

cargo_straps.basis: Seller displayed price; manufacturer125g and0.8kN working force. Product force is not a rating of the assembled deck/slots.

fasteners_and_extra_slotnuts.basis: Six M6x30, twelve M6 grade A washers plus sorting spares, six HNTT6-6, eight M4x25/washer/nut sets; purchasing units and personal MISUMI supply unresolved.

edge_protection_and_slack_retention.basis: Protect all webbing/metal contact edges and secure tails; final pad selection unconfirmed.

machining.operations: Ten stock cuts; six support D6.6 holes and eight stop D4.5 holes. Deck all50 round holes+four slots and deburring included in CNC quotation.

procurement.note: No order or inquiry sent. Seller price is not a delivered machining quote or a guarantee of stock; regional shipping/cart combination must be checked. Container/load-spreader is cargo and unselected. Existing battery straps remain separate.
procurement.excluded_tools: Drill/saw/vice, deburring tools and strap force measuring equipment unselected; no tool costs or labor included.

mass_budget.note: Recomputed nominal shapes plus complete catalog straps. Nonstructural PLA fixtures accounted in full assembly.
